articles.summary: In the latest addition to its expanding AI capabilities, international law firm Simmons & Simmons has today announced that it has partnered with Legora to deploy the legal AI platform across the firm.
articles.title: Simmons & Simmons builds on AI frontrunner status with partnership with Legora

articles.summary: Crowell & Moring LLP today shared results from its firmwide integration of Legora as a collaborative AI platform. Crowell has realized significant gains in opportunities to deliver for clients across practices and jurisdictions.
articles.title: Crowell & Moring marks six months of Legora integration with transformative results across global platform

articles.summary: Legora today announced that it is acquiring London-based Wexler, the fact intelligence platform that extracts, verifies, and reasons over the factual record from large and unstructured document sets, used by some of the world's leading litigation and disputes teams at Clifford Chance, Goodwin, and Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer, as well as in-house legal and compliance teams at large global enterprises. Wexler's engineering team will form the founding team of Legora's London engineering hub.
articles.title: Legora is acquiring Wexler to bring fact intelligence to agentic legal work

articles.summary: DKSH, the Swiss Market Expansion Services provider with CHF 11.1 billion in net sales and operations across 35 jurisdictions, has selected Legora as its agentic AI platform for legal professionals.
articles.title: DKSH deploys Legora globally

articles.summary: Johanna Pernborn is the CTO of Tax & Legal at Deloitte Sweden and for Tax & Legal Nordics. It’s a job that sits at the intersection of two disciplines: deep legal and tax expertise on one side, and the technology reshaping how that expertise gets produced and delivered on the other.
articles.title: Johanna Pernborn on transforming tax and legal service delivery at Deloitte and the case for co-developing specialist tools

articles.summary: The firmwide rollout of Legora builds on Fasken’s early and ongoing work in agentic legal AI.
articles.title: Fasken accelerates its legal AI journey with Legora partnership

articles.summary: Legora and Tinexta partner to bring exclusive, authoritative Italian legal content—case law, legislation, and commentary—to the Legora platform, powered by LextelAI.
articles.title: Legora and Tinexta in exclusive partnership to bring full corpus of Italian legal content directly to Legora

articles.summary: Nearly 100,000-square-foot Manhattan office will anchor Legora's North American growth, supporting engineering, product and legal engineering teams.
articles.title: Legora announces major New York City expansion

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals trusted by more than 100,000 lawyers at more than 1,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets, today announced the opening of an office in Seoul, marking the company's entry into South Korea. The office is Legora's fourth in Asia-Pacific, following Sydney, Singapore and Tokyo.
articles.title: Legora expands to South Korea with new office in Seoul

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals trusted by more than 100,000 lawyers at more than 1,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 50 markets, today announced the opening of an office in Mexico City – its first in Latin America.
articles.title: Legora enters Latin America with a new Mexico City office

articles.summary: Arthur Cox LLP, one of Ireland's leading law firms, has selected Legora as a strategic partner to support the next phase of its AI strategy, with a firm-wide rollout now underway.
articles.title: Arthur Cox LLP partners with Legora to scale its AI-enabled legal services

articles.summary: The Mumbai firm has selected Legora as its legal AI platform after a rigorous evaluation.
articles.title: Veritas Legal selects Legora as its legal AI partner

articles.summary: Niederer Kraft Frey (NKF), one of Switzerland’s leading commercial law firms, has partnered with Legora to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence across the firm.
articles.title: Niederer Kraft Frey and Legora announce strategic partnership to advance AI-powered legal services
